result:
That's a fascinating and thought-provoking question. If I could change the world in one way, I think I would work to foster greater empathy, compassion and understanding between all people. I believe that so much of the conflict, suffering and division in the world stems from a lack of empathy - an inability or unwillingness to see things from another's perspective, to recognize our common humanity. 

If I could wave a magic wand, I would imbue every person with a stronger capacity for empathy and a deeper appreciation for the inherent worth and dignity of every human being, regardless of differences in culture, religion, political ideology, socioeconomic status, etc. I think that cultivating that empathy and sense of our shared bonds as a species could go a long way towards addressing so many of the world's pressing challenges - poverty, oppression, war, environmental destruction, and so on.

Of course, it's a complex issue and there are no simple solutions. But I do believe that nurturing a greater ethic of care, concern and compassion for one another could be truly transformative. What are your thoughts on this? How would you change the world if you had that power?
